events.title: Marcus Shelby Quartet-A Keys Birthday Celebration!
performers: Marcus Shelby Quartet-A Keys Birthday Celebration!
events.description: Join us as one of the Bay Area's prominent band leaders helps us celebrate four years at Keys! Marcus Anthony Shelby is a composer, bassist, bandleader, and educator who currently lives in San Francisco, California.
